text:
Ana Rivera: idea: add an edge 'slimbridge' that strips high-cardinality attrs but preserves a deterministic billing_key + optional short-lived attr_ref for reconciling later.
CJ Park: sounds doable. requirement: exact list of canonical keys and billing_key derivation must be computed at edge.
Michael Li: tradeoffs: late-join correctness and degraded debuggability if attrs are removed early.
Sara Gupta: sampling question: if sampling happens after pruning we lose attribution. either sample at edge or provide an attr_ref so enrichment can fetch attrs for late samples.
Ana Rivera: attr_ref approach: set header x-attr-ref = sha256(trace_id + ts); write full attrs to enrichment-cache with TTL=48h only for billing-sensitive routes.
CJ Park: billing_key rule: tenant_billing_id if present else sha256(tenant_id + '|' + route). compute before pruning. ops: KMS + RBAC for cache.
Michael Li: prefer reusing enrichment-cache service. rough hot storage: 1KB * 1M traces/day * 10% flagged -> ~200GB hot for 48h; CJ to validate.
Sara Gupta: rollout: feature-flag per-route, canary 1% low-risk routes for 24h, monitor billing delta + "attr-missing" regressions.
ingest-bot: created checklist item #3124 for "edge-slimbridge-gate" (assignee: CJ Park).
Ana Rivera: actions: CJ -> capacity + toggle PR; Michael -> cache reuse spike; Sara -> SLIs + canary checklist; me -> RFC update. target: land behind flag in two sprints.
